items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow, ruled out after cart, X-rays negative no fracture; additional testing Monday. HC Quinn notes expected to miss time (prior similar injury ~1 month).
items.why: Dislocated left elbow on awkward fall bracing; X-rays clean but miss time expected.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota in; major Commanders offense downgrade, WRs/TEs and streamers elevated short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and pass-catchers see volume spike while Daniels out.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury, carted off, replaced by Tyson Bagent; scheduled for imaging/MRI Monday. Walking under own power postgame with slight limp.
items.why: Hamstring grab while scrambling; carted, imaging Monday.
items.implication: Bagent at QB; Bears offense limited, check severity for Week 3.
items.opportunity: If multi-week, elevated role for remaining skill players and backup QB streaming.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) true game-time decision / pre-game for MNF vs Giants; missed practices, Schefter notes pre-game decision and later trending wrong direction more likely out. Whittington doubtful.
items.why: Hip/groin soreness, DNPs; true GTD per Levitan/ETR/Schefter.
items.implication: If out, Adams primary, heavier TE/run, Mumpfield/Fields bumps; risky start.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams target spike; secondary WRs/TEs if both Nacua/Whittington miss.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley suffered stinger, missed most of first half but returned with neck roll and played through; MRI today with hope it is minor.
items.why: Stinger; played through after missing early action.
items.implication: Monitor MRI; if clear likely full go Week 3, else handcuff elevated.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, increased carries for Eagles backup RBs.

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak on TE Brock Bowers (knee): 'Close, very close. He looks great.' Missed W2 (doubtful/inactive) after limited practice/pregame warmup; eyeing Week 3 debut.
items.why: Meniscus recovery progressing; Kubiak optimistic post-warmup.
items.implication: Elite TE1 if active W3; Mayer continues short-term.
items.opportunity: Bowers full routes/targets upon return in Kubiak offense.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) officially ACTIVE; played through with flak jacket possible, finished 3/35 as somewhat decoy.
items.why: Optimism + Rap bullish tone; confirmed active and suited up.
items.implication: WR2 with docks; limited efficiency this week but role intact ROS if heals.
items.opportunity: Continued high target share once fully healthy; Johnston secondary.
items.conflict: Played limited volume vs pregame optimism.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) inactive; grab Jonah Coleman. JK Dobbins paces backfield.
items.why: Hamstring; not expected then confirmed inactive.
items.implication: Dobbins lead back; Coleman gets look in passing/change-of-pace.
items.opportunity: Dobbins carries/RZ spike; Coleman waiver/stash for committee share.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) and Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) both officially ACTIVE/expected and played.
items.why: Burrow back tightness cleared; Olave hamstring clean per Levitan no docks.
items.implication: Full go for both; Burrow stack and Olave WR1 viable.

items.text: Michael Pittman (foot) OUT; expecting decent look at Germie Bernard.
items.implication: Bernard (YAC fit with McCarthy) and slot options elevated.
items.opportunity: Bernard stash/waiver for targets; Colts WR committee shift.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks (Rap bullish); Puka true GTD; Olave clean no docks; decent look Jonah Coleman (Harvey doubtful) and Germie Bernard (Pittman out).
items.why: Practice/report tone + Rap optimism for McConkey; clean for Olave; absence-driven for backups.
items.implication: McConkey startable w/ caution; Puka pivot ready; Coleman/Bernard stashes.
items.opportunity: Coleman/Bernard volume from teammate absences; McConkey routes if docks light.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) OUT. Opens door for Rashod Bateman big game.
items.implication: Bateman primary WR beneficiary in Ravens passing game.

items.text: RIDE OR DIE on DeVonta Smith: 27%/38% target shares first two games, leads all WRs in expected PPR this week per model.
items.why: Elite target share and model expected points.
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2; strong ROS if volume holds.

items.text: With Jordan Mason (thumb) on IR, Vikings went full Aaron Jones: 42 snaps vs Dallas 8 / Claiborne 2. Faces TB/MIA/NO before Mason expected return.
items.why: Mason IR opens clear lead role; snap domination confirmed.
items.implication: Jones every-down RB1 short-term with favorable upcoming slate.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans hip injury not serious per HC Shanahan; could have returned in 4th if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle sprain.
items.implication: Likely available soon/full; minimal long-term ding.
items.opportunity: Normal WR role expected next week.
